title: Director of Operations Support & Program Management (Remote w/travel required)
text:
Overview:

**At Anne Arundel Dermatology we give exceptional care - to our patients and to eachother.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patient First | Caring | Accountability | Trust | One Team | Growth

Founded 50+ years ago with a mission to provide the highest quality and full spectrum of medical, surgical, and esthetic skin care services to each and every one of its patients, Anne Arundel Dermatology has assembled the finest group of dermatologists in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern states. With 250+ clinicians and 110+ locations in 7 states, we’re thriving, growing, and looking to add talented individuals to our team!

**Why join Anne Arundel Dermatology?**

We are committed to continual training and education for our physicians and staff. We are on top of the latest developments in dermatology including ongoing research, emerging treatments, new medications and prevention methods. You can find more than just a job with Anne Arundel Dermatology. We believe in providing our new associates with intensive hands on training and long-term career growth opportunities from within.

If you are looking for a career with a busy, fast paced medical office, then joining the Anne Arundel Dermatology’s Surgery Center team is for you! We are looking for highly motivated, self-starting individuals, who work efficiently and are detail oriented, to join our team. You will not only be working alongside a large administrative team, but also with some of the top Moh’s Surgeons in the area. This is a great opportunity to be a part of our vast growing practice or an essential stepping stone for anyone looking to advance their career in the administrative side of the medical field.

**DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS SUPPORT & PROGRAM MANAGEMENT**

***Job Summary:***

The **Director of Operations Support & Program Management** provides strategic and operational leadership for enterprise operations support, project management, technology optimization, process improvement, and training. Serving as the central link between Operations, IT, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Clinical, Aesthetics, Marketing, and vendors, the Director removes operational barriers, translates operational needs into effective systems, workflows, and training, and ensures enterprise initiatives are implemented, adopted, and sustained.

Salary range of 140,000-160,000 annually, plus 20% bonus opportunity.

Responsibilities:

***Duties/Responsibilities:***

**Operations Support & Operational Excellence**

* Lead the Operations Support function and serve as the escalation point for complex operational and cross-functional issues.
* Establish and maintain standardized SOPs, workflows, and operational processes across the organization.
* Use process-analysis reporting to identify operational barriers and implement solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and communication.
* Support provider onboarding and operational readiness, site moves, and other organizational changes.
* Maintain regular communication cadences with support functions, including Aesthetics and Marketing, to surface and resolve issues proactively.

**Enterprise Program & Project Management**

* Lead or oversee major cross-functional initiatives (e.g., telephony transformation, Assist Tracking/LIS transition, Medsender and AI Scribe implementations, and aesthetic online scheduling).
* Own the initiative portfolio, managing intake, prioritization, and sequencing of requests against team and field capacity.
* Establish project priorities, timelines, ownership, and deliverables using a consistent methodology (charters, stage gates, go-live readiness, hypercare, post-implementation reviews); identify risks, dependencies, resource needs, and operational impacts.
* Coordinate stakeholders across Operations, IT, clinical teams, RCM, and vendors from planning through adoption and stabilization, and manage vendor statements of work, timelines, and project budgets.
* Provide leadership with regular reporting on project progress, risks, and outcomes, including delivery measures such as on-time go-lives and adoption.

**Software Management & Digital Innovation**

* Provide strategic oversight of the operational software ecosystem (e.g., ModMed, Relatient, Klara, HubSpot, Medsender, Brevium, Birdeye, Zocdoc, and self-scheduling tools), including interface and workflow monitoring.
* Partner with IT to define system requirements, identify gaps, and implement workflow solutions; manage vendor relationships and enhancement priorities.
* Evaluate automation, integration, and digital innovation opportunities that improve the patient and provider experience.
* Establish governance for ongoing system optimization and ensure system changes are supported by sustainable workflows, training, and adoption.

**Training & Continuous Process Improvement**

* Oversee standardized training for Time of Service, new hires, providers, aesthetic processes and discounts, clinical documentation, and system or workflow changes.
* Partner with RCM and clinical leadership to address documentation deficiencies; monitor compliance and performance indicators to identify retraining needs.
* Keep training materials aligned with current SOPs and technology, and lead a culture in which process changes are implemented, measured, and refined.

**MIPS & Regulatory/Performance Initiatives**

* Lead operational coordination of MIPS activities, partnering with clinical, operational, and RCM stakeholders to operationalize requirements.
* Monitor progress, address barriers, and integrate MIPS requirements into workflows, training, documentation, and reporting.

Qualifications:

***Required Skills/Abilities:***

* Change management
* Project leadership, strategic thinking and data-driven decision making
* Process improvement and technology enablement
* Executive communication, cross-functional relationship management, accountability and follow-through

Licensure/Certifications/Education:

***Education and Experience:***

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, operations, information systems, or related field, **or** 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, practice management, operational transformation, or project management.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional technology implementations, system optimization, integrations, and workflow redesign.
* Strong knowledge of SOP development, change management, and staff and provider training.
* Ability to manage multiple enterprise-level priorities and translate complex operational or technical issues into practical solutions.
* Experience working effectively with executive leadership, physicians/providers, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Regularly required to sit for extended periods.
* Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a keyboard, mouse, and telephone.
* Occasionally required to stand and walk.
* Talking and listening in person and on the telephone.
* Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds.
* 25% travel required, possibly up to 50%

**Full time employees (defined as regularly working at least 30 hours per week) are eligible for the following benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision insurance – effective 1st of the month after date of start
* Short-term and long-term disability, Voluntary life (employee, spouse, and child), Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity – Effective the 1st of the month following date of hire
* Company provided Basic Life/AD&D insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
* Retirement Savings account
* Employee discount on cosmetic services and products
